notes.title: Fixed bugs
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed some dialogues that were apparently not translated into English.  
[*] Fixed an issue where, during the "truth or dare" game, when Arisa dared Ayaka to reach an orgasm at Reika's hands, the first video showed Kotomi pleasing Ayaka instead of Reika.  
[/list]
Thank you to everyone enjoying the game! Have a great day!

notes.title: Added Chinese language and bug fixed
notes.notes:
The game can now be played in English, Spanish, and Chinese.
Following the last game update, an error on my part blocked endings 8-12. Those endings can now be played again. I sincerely apologize for this inconvenience.
Have a great day!

notes.notes: Nothing important has changed, just a dialogue that was said by the wrong character.
